verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Foreloop's task orchestration, PR review scoring, and feedback-to-task workflow, but nowhere does it mention an agent automatically generating or running tests to validate its own code changes before proposing a PR. The 'automatic product reviews' (foreloop-docs-22/23) are post-PR review/scoring by Foreloop itself, not self-generated test creation/execution by the agent prior to proposing changes.
